title: Scope moving the repo public -> private at ~zero cost, plus a security redesign (secrets, VM access, CI/research compute) -- feasibility memo + transition plan, no changes
note: [2026-10-08T10:10Z manager] OPERATOR ASK 2026-10-08 (verbatim excerpts): "scope out what it would take to move the repo from public to private. We have a lot of dependency on free resources that we get from the public repo that would need to be replaced, and I prefer not to pay for them. Also ... brainstorm how we can make the system more secure as part of this transition" ... (1) free research compute on GitHub, alternatives: run on the VM, other free burst sources, or piggyback the GPU burst infra; (2) free GitHub Actions we would lose -- both automation/compute AND the manager's access to the VM; find free alternatives that keep full technical control; (3) move secrets off GitHub secrets to a more secure, organised system, idea: Google Colab one-click notebook that uploads keys to the VM -- open to other flows "as long as they don't require technical activities from me (I want to be able to just manage the key list and let the system take care of the rest)". Priority: not high; this week only if capacity (after ML-RESEARCH-W41 under the one-lane rule). Deliverable: inventory of every public-repo dependency (Actions minutes per workflow over 30d, Pages, relays, secrets, issue-driven system-actions, diag relays), private-repo cost/limits verified from current GitHub docs, alternatives ranked by cost and risk (leading hypothesis to verify, NOT a fact: self-hosted runners on our own VMs are free for private repos and keep the workflows), secrets-flow options incl. the Colab idea, a phased plan with a reversible first step. One Sonnet lane, ceiling $15, memo PR only. [2026-10-08 lane Sonnet] Memo docs/research/repo-private-transition-2026-10-08.md (branch claude/repo-private-scope-k7q2). Findings: ~525k hosted min/mo sampled vs 2,000 free on private -> hosted runners unaffordable; self-hosted runners free (fee postponed, not cancelled); personal Free plan loses branch protection on private; July 6-7 private/public flip precedent. Phased plan inside; 4 operator decisions in section 5.
